messages:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for model embed-service v0.10 -> detecting latency/error deviation...

deploy-bot: ...details: sample_rate=5%, region=us-east-1, 5xx_spike=3.2%, baseline=0.1%, p95 latency 1.2s->4.8s :rotating_light:

amanda: ...seeing this in dashboard too, alerts triggered. tagging @rishi oncall

rishi: on it. is this affecting host + dedicated? any customer-facing errors?

amanda: host users in us-east seeing timeouts on embedding calls (request-level 504). error logs attached below.

amanda: ```
[2026-03-15T02:12:03Z] embed-service v0.10 ERROR inference timeout id=abc123 model=embed-large seq_len=1024 latency=4800ms
[2026-03-15T02:12:04Z] upstream: grpc: deadline exceeded
```

incident-bot: PagerDuty alert created (PD-INC-6231) and paging rishi

rishi: thanks. quick check: can we route traffic back to v0.9 while we investigate? what's the rollout handle?

amanda: rollout id canary-20260315-embed. current traffic: 25% -> v0.10

rishi: ok. executing kill-switch -> set traffic 0% for v0.10

ken: I'm applying the traffic rollback now.

ken: ```
# rollback command
redwood rollout update --id canary-20260315-embed --traffic v0.10=0 v0.9=100
# or via console: canary > abort
```

deploy-bot: Rollout update accepted. v0.10 traffic -> 0%. v0.9 back to 100%.

deploy-bot: Health check: p95 latency back to 0.9s, 5xx rate -> 0.12% (10m windows)

emma: verified in canary logs. regression repros with long seq_len + kv-cache flush in v0.10. failing path seems quantized op fallback.

rishi: noted. this looks like a kernel/quant path issue under high token length. we'll pin v0.9 for now. I'll start a debug job to reproduce on a dev rig with the same config.

paul: what's the customer impact? any enterprise customers hit or SLO breaches?

amanda: quick numbers: ~1200 embedding requests failed over the last 20m, affecting ~8% of host traffic for embeddings in us-east. No dedicated reserved-capacity tenants reported errors. No billing impact yet, but some user-facing errors in search index pipelines.

paul: ok please log a customer incident, I'll coordinate comms if this widens. tag me for updates.

rishi: handing off to night on-call @maya for monitoring overnight and coordinating with model team tomorrow.

maya: acknowledged, taking handoff. I'll keep PD on watch and ensure alerts are dimmed to product thresholds. please paste playbook steps for escalation.

rishi: playbook (short):
1) ensure v0.9 pinned (done)
2) if 5xx > 1% for >15m, escalate to runtime leads and contact model-ops
3) collect sample traces and kernel logs: /var/log/embed/trace-*.log
4) avoid full rollback unless traffic > 50% and impact > 25% customers

emma: adding unit/regression tests for seq_len edgecases and quant-fallback path. will open PR with test harness tomorrow.

ken: created incident ticket: INC-2026-0315-embed-rollback

amanda: updating status page: `Investigating -> Mitigated (traffic reverted to v0.9).`

maya: taking ownership. follow-ups: postmortem + long-term fix tracking. I'll set a 0900 sync with runtime + model team.

rishi: thanks team. closing pager for now, re-open if symptoms reappear. :white_check_mark:

paul: noted for customer comms. good catch on quick kill-switch.

amanda: react :thumbsup: to confirm visibility.

deploy-bot: Incident closed (PD-INC-6231) by rishi at 2026-03-15T02:28:00Z
